notes:
Diwen integration is updated to 6.16.3. Private concepts retain their IDs and definitions in agent exchanges.

## What changed since 0.4.53

- Use Diwen's latest published open-data package and include its CC BY 4.0 LICENSE and attribution NOTICE, by Pondsi (https://github.com/Pondsi/Diwen).
- Fix the in-app update path: load the actual npm entry, show the running package version, prevent an older update from replacing a newer bundled version, and check health before activating an update.
- Keep private concept identities through mapping and deterministic rendering. Private package import, export and removal remain supported.
- Bundle the segmentation and pinyin dependencies needed by the isolated Diwen worker.

## Boundaries

Mechanical mapping is not semantic approval. Unsupported or uncertain input remains the original text; this update does not add cloud model calls or rewrite chat originals. Diwen updates are still installed only when you request them.

## Install

Download WArmy-Setup-0.4.54.exe and run it. Existing WArmyData carries over. The installer is unsigned; Windows SmartScreen may ask for confirmation.
